facts.text: I felt overwhelmed after a week off from work.
I needed help organizing my tasks.
I have a mix of work and personal tasks.
Some of my tasks have deadlines.
I have been putting off a few tasks since before I took my week off.
I need to finish a project report for work that is overdue.
I need to book a flight for an upcoming trip.
I need to sort through hundreds of family reunion photos.
I need to create an album from the family reunion photos.
I want to start a new exercise routine.
I need to research some workout plans.
I need to respond to some work emails that I missed during my week off.
I need to make a doctor's appointment for a check-up.
I want to plan a dinner party for some friends who helped me with the family reunion preparations.
